Calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain: in human, mice and pigs

Humans
```{r}
total_human <- sum(180 + 83 + 57 + 110)
print(total_human)
```

Pigs
```{r}
total_pig <- sum(109 + 157 + 31 + 45)
print(total_pig)
```

Mice
```{r}
total_mice <- sum(55 + 185 + 60 + 98)
print(total_mice)
```
